sample_1.prompt: A young man in business casual attire standing at an office desk, head bowed slightly and expression earnest as he apologizes to a seated female colleague who listens with a calm, understanding face. Soft natural light from nearby windows, modern open-plan office in the background. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, neutral warm tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: A distressed woman at a cafe table, hands pressed together in sincere apology, facing a man whose laptop has coffee spilled across the keyboard. The man looks surprised but not angry. Coffee drips off the table edge. Warm cafe lighting, blurred patrons in background. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm amber tones, candid cinematic composition.

sample_3.prompt: A composed CEO in a dark suit standing behind a podium with multiple press microphones, head slightly bowed and expression grave, delivering a formal public apology. Reporters and camera flashes visible in the blurred foreground. Corporate backdrop with company logo. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, cool dramatic tones, cinematic wide composition.
